8274.commemoration: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ
8274.label: the feast
8274.removed_because: mis-parsed: concluding TROPARION from the St Sergius Vespers page, not a sticheron. See backlog N1.
8274.text: In their sufferings, Thy martyrs O Lord, * received imperishable crowns from Thee, our God; * for, possessed of Thy might, * they set at naught the tyrants and crushed the feeble audacity of the demons. ** By their supplications save Thou our souls.

8275.commemoration: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ
8275.label: the feast
8275.removed_because: mis-parsed: concluding TROPARION from the St Sergius Vespers page, not a sticheron. See backlog N1.
8275.text: Troparion of the venerable martyrs, in the same tone: O God of our fathers, * ever deal with us according to Thy meekness. * Take not Thy mercy from us, * but by the prayers of these saints ** direct our life in peace.

8276.commemoration: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ
8276.label: the feast
8276.removed_because: mis-parsed: concluding TROPARION from the St Sergius Vespers page, not a sticheron. See backlog N1.
8276.text: Troparion of the feast When Thou wast baptized in the Jordan, O Lord, * the worship of the Trinity was made manifest: * for the voice of the Father bare witness unto Thee * calling Thee His beloved Son; * and the Spirit in the guise of a dove * confirmed the certainty of His words. * O Christ God, Who hast appeared ** and enlightened the world, glory be to Thee!

8319.label: the apostle
8319.removed_because: mis-parsed: concluding TROPARION from the St Sergius Vespers page, not a sticheron. See backlog N1.
8319.text: Learning goodness and being sober in all things * with a good conscience, arrayed as a priest * thou didst draw forth things ineffable from the chosen vessel; * and having kept the faith, thou didst finish the even course. ** O Apostle Timothy, entreat Christ God, that our souls be saved.

8320.label: the apostle
8320.removed_because: mis-parsed: concluding TROPARION from the St Sergius Vespers page, not a sticheron. See backlog N1.
8320.text: Troparion of the venerable martyr In his suffering, O Lord, Thy martyr Anastasius * received an imperishable crown from Thee, our God; * for, possessed of Thy might, * he set at naught the tormenters and crushed the feeble audacity of the demons. ** By his supplications save Thou our souls.

8536.commemoration: Apostles Jason and Sosipater of the Seventy, the Virgin Kerkyra, and those with them
8536.label: the holy martyrs
8536.removed_because: mis-parsed: concluding TROPARION of the holy apostles, not a sticheron. Text survives as troparia 38135. See backlog N1.
8536.text: O holy Apostles * entreat the Merciful God * that He grant remission of sins ** unto our souls

8563.label: the holy prophet
8563.removed_because: mis-parsed: concluding TROPARION from the St Sergius Vespers page, not a sticheron. See backlog N1.
8563.text: Celebrating the memory * of Thy Prophet Isaiah, O Lord, * through him we entreat Thee: ** Save Thou our souls!

8564.label: the holy prophet
8564.removed_because: mis-parsed: concluding TROPARION from the St Sergius Vespers page, not a sticheron. See backlog N1.
8564.text: Troparion of the holy martyr Arrayed in vesture dyed with thine own blood, * thou standest before the King of hosts, O ever-memorable Christopher; * therefore, with the incorporeal ones and the martyrs * thou dost sing thrice-holy and awesome melodies. ** Wherefore, by thy supplications save thou thy flock.

8737.label: the venerable martyr
8737.removed_because: mis-parsed: concluding TROPARION from the St Sergius Vespers page, not a sticheron. See backlog N1.
8737.text: O prophet and forerunner of the coming of Christ, * we who honor thee with love * are at a loss how to worthily praise thee; * for by thy glorious and honored nativity * thou didst loose the barrenness of her who gave birth to thee * and the muteness of thy father, ** and proclaimed to the world the incarnation of the Son of God.

8738.label: the venerable martyr
8738.removed_because: mis-parsed: concluding TROPARION from the St Sergius Vespers page, not a sticheron. See backlog N1.
8738.text: Troparion of the venerable martyr Thy ewe-lamb Febronia, O Jesus crieth out with a loud voice: * “Thee do I love, O my Bridegroom, * and, seeking Thee, I endure suffering. * In Thy baptism I am crucified and buried with Thee. * I suffer for Thy sake, that I may reign with Thee; * I die for Thee, that I may live with Thee. * Accept me, who with love sacrifice myself for Thee, * as an unblemished offering!” ** By her supplications, in that Thou art merciful, save Thou our souls.

8854.commemoration: Martyr Emilian of Silistria in Bulgaria
8854.label: the holy martyr
8854.removed_because: mis-parsed: concluding TROPARION from the St Sergius Vespers page, not a sticheron. See backlog N1.
8854.text: In his sufferings, Thy martyr Emilian O Lord, * received an imperishable crown from Thee, our God; * for, possessed of Thy might, * he set at naught the tyrants and crushed the feeble audacity of the demons. ** By his supplications save Thou our souls.

8949.text: In their sufferings, Thy martyrs O Lord, * received imperishable crowns from Thee, our God; * for, possessed of Thy might, * they set at naught the tyrants and crushed the feeble audacity of the demons. ** By their supplications save Thou our souls.

8950.commemoration: Afterfeast of the Transfiguration of our Lord
8950.label: the feast
8950.removed_because: mis-parsed: this is a concluding TROPARION from the St Sergius Vespers page, not a sticheron. See docs/backlog-2026-08-29-vespers-liturgy-review.md N1.
8950.text: Troparion of the venerable one O instructor of Orthodoxy, teacher of piety and purity, * luminary of all the world, divinely inspired adornment of monastics: * O most wise Maximus, by thy doctrines thou hast enlightened all ** O harp of the Spirit, entreat Christ God, that our souls be saved.

8951.commemoration: Afterfeast of the Transfiguration of our Lord
8951.label: the feast
8951.removed_because: mis-parsed: this is a concluding TROPARION from the St Sergius Vespers page, not a sticheron. See docs/backlog-2026-08-29-vespers-liturgy-review.md N1.
8951.text: Troparion of the feast Thou wast transfigured on the mountain, O Christ, our God, * showing to Thy disciples Thy glory as each one could endure. * Shine forth Thou on us, who are sinners all, * Thy light ever-unending. * Through the prayers of the Theotokos, ** Light-Bestower, glory to Thee.

9066.commemoration: Hieromartyr Anthimus, Bishop of Nicomedia and those with him
9066.label: the holy hieromartyr
9066.removed_because: mis-parsed: concluding TROPARION from the St Sergius Vespers page, not a sticheron. See backlog N1.
9066.text: As thou didst share in the ways of the apostles * and didst occupy their throne, * thou didst find thine activity to be a passage to divine vision, * O divinely inspired one. * Wherefore, ordering the word of truth, * thou didst suffer for the Faith even to the shedding of thy blood, ** O Hieromartyr Anthimus, entreat Christ God, that our souls be saved.

9067.commemoration: Hieromartyr Anthimus, Bishop of Nicomedia and those with him
9067.label: the holy hieromartyr
9067.removed_because: mis-parsed: concluding TROPARION from the St Sergius Vespers page, not a sticheron. See backlog N1.
9067.text: Troparion of the venerable one With the streams of thy tears thou didst irrigate the barren desert, * and with sighs from the depths of thy soul thou didst render thy labors fruitful an hundredfold, * becoming a beacon for the whole world, resplendent with miracles. ** O Theoctistus our father, entreat Christ God, that our souls be saved.

9252.removed_because: mis-parsed: concluding TROPARION from the St Sergius Vespers page, not a sticheron. See backlog N1.
9252.text: O holy Apostle Phillip, * entreat the Merciful God * that He grant remission of sins ** unto our souls

9253.commemoration: Commemoration of the Holy Fathers of the Seventh Ecumenical Council
9253.label: the venerable one
9253.removed_because: mis-parsed: concluding TROPARION from the St Sergius Vespers page, not a sticheron. See backlog N1.
9253.text: Troparion of the venerable one Teacher of Orthodoxy, instructor of piety and chastity, * luminary of the Church, God-inspired instructor of Hierarchs, * O supremely wise Theophanes thou hast illumined all by thy teaching; ** entreat Christ God that our souls be saved.
